exposure: oxycodone consumption in the 24 hour prior to discharge
outcome: Proportion of patients discharged without an opioid prescription
finding: Implementation of a tailored opioid prescribing algorithm based on inpatient opioid use was associated with a significant reduction in the number of oxycodone tablets prescribed and an increased proportion of patients discharged without an opioid prescription.
mod_finding: This study found that a tailored opioid prescribing algorithm, based on inpatient opioid use, reduced the number of opioid tablets prescribed after cesarean delivery and increased the proportion of patients discharged without an opioid prescription.
